parameters.name: All
parameters.description: Specifies whether to remove all tags. Default value: false. This parameter is valid only when TagKey is left empty. Valid values: true and false.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid value: Valid values:

*   **DOMAIN**: domain name

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The tags added to the resource.
